content: {"question":"Which external resources are recommended for GitLab managers to use when coaching former peers on remote work practices?","answer":"GitLab managers should use the Harvard Business Review article “How to Manage Your Former Peers” and the Lynda.com course “Coping successfully with your transition.”","evidence_a":"- [How to Manage Your Former Peers, Harvard Business Review](https://hbr.org/2012/12/how-to-manage-your-former-peer)","evidence_b":"- [Coping successfully with your transition, Lynda.com](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/new-manager-foundations-21965262)"}
